mapper.select: SELECT category_id, name, category_order FROM categories ORDER BY category_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, category_order) SELECT #{name}, COALESCE(MAX(category_order), 0) + 1 FROM (SELECT category_order FROM categories) AS temp
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET category_order = CASE WHEN category_id = #{categoryId} THEN #{newOrder} WHEN category_order >= #{newOrder} AND category_order < #{oldOrder} THEN category_order + 1 WHEN category_order <= #{newOrder} AND category_order > #{oldOrder} THEN category_order - 1 ELSE category_order END WHERE category_order BETWEEN COALESCE(#{minOrder}, 0) AND COALESCE(#{maxOrder}, 1000000)
